findings.message: U101 (LM74700-Q1): V(CATHODE-ANODE) 68 vs rating 75 (91%) (PVA_P to PVA_IN) — above 80% derating
findings.waived_by: designer: Interval artefact: 68 V pairs +35 V on PVx_P (the back-feed bound) with the string reversed at -33 V. The two cannot coexist: PVx_P can only be raised by the LM5176 running backwards (review M1), and the LM5176 cannot start with the string reversed because its VIN is PVx_P itself, which decays to 0 V behind the blocking LM74700 (EN/UVLO on >= 7.5 V). With the string reversed V(CATHODE-ANODE) <= 33 V + residual (44 % of 75 V); with it forward, ANODE >= 0 and V(CATHODE-ANODE) <= 35 V.

findings.message: R470 (10M) bridges isolated domains HV (pins ['1']) and LV (pins ['2']) without a rated isolation between those pins
findings.waived_by: designer: IMD bridge (review M3): each pole is 11 x 10 MOhm in series (110 MOhm) between HV and CHASSIS, a protective impedance in the sense of IEC 61140:2016 5.1.x [S]: <= 3.8 uA at 420 V (<< 2 mA DC touch limit), any one resistor shorted still leaves 100 MOhm and 4.2 uA; each resistor sees <= 42 V (21 % of its 200 V rating). The string crosses the 10 mm barrier band as >= 4 series resistors with nothing else in the band; R470/R481 are just the parts the framework sees changing domain.

findings.message: external hv net HV_N reaches the board without a fuse/PTC on it
findings.waived_by: designer: These nets are fused where the energy is: F901/F902 sit first from the pack at the battery end and D901 blocks pack current toward the cable; from our side HV_P is current-limited (0.30 A cap, 0.40 A latch, < 0.85 A physical). PACK_SNS has 3 MOhm in series at the battery end (<= 133 uA).

findings.message: external power net PVA_IN reaches the board without a fuse/PTC on it
findings.waived_by: designer: A PV string is a current source (Isc 6.3 A at 1 sun, 7.3 A worst case) below every rating in its path (J101 12 A, 2.5 mm2 cable, Q101 100 A); one string per input, no parallel strings to back-feed it, so no string fuse is needed [S: IEC 62548 requires string fuses only for >= 3 parallel strings].

findings.message: Q-3 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Measure the Prime roof (template) and confirm the 8 x 7 field; any roof rack/antenna conflicts?

Q-4 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Get the 2017-2022 Prius Prime repair manual pages for the HV battery junction block: SMRB/SMRP/SMRG, CHRB/CHRG and current-sensor positions, and the cell-side tap studs. Our - tap should sit on the relay side of the car's current sensor so the battery ECU counts our current when it is awake.

Q-5 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Who installs the pack-side tap (HV-trained technician, service-plug procedure, 10-minute wait [P])? A tap on the cell side of the SMRs means opening the sealed pack case and adding a sealed penetration. Is that acceptable to insurer, registration and warranty?
Q-6 is BLOCKING and unanswered: How is the array fixed to the roof (bonded flexible laminate vs rails)? Detachment at speed (HZ-9).

Q-10 is BLOCKING and unanswered: How does the Prime battery ECU re-estimate SOC after charge added while asleep, and does it set DTCs? Validate on the car (V-23) before parked charging is enabled by default.

Q-13 is BLOCKING and unanswered: What are the Prime's pack voltage and maximum cell voltage at the end of a full plug-in charge (Techstream/OBD log, warm and cold), and its displayed vs true SOC window? No Toyota, Panasonic or teardown source was found (ANL D3 gives only 95 cells, 351.5 V, 25 Ah).
Pin HGND not connected to ground net: Symbol U401 Pin 8 [HGND, Power input, Line]
findings.waived_by: designer: HGND of U401/U421/U441/U461 is the isolated high-side ground, tied to the HV domain reference HV_N / HV_RTN as the AMC datasheets require; KiCad's rule only recognises nets named like GND.
